note: UTE-3 per-family inventory of the legacy ToolPlane / Family Body (dev/agent-workflow/ledgers/ute-family-inventory.json). WHAT IT IS: for every family booked in dev/agent-workflow/ledgers/arc-a-family-census.json, the repo-relative files that genuinely constitute its current implementation (chosen by reading the code, never by directory name), the model-visible definitions it contributes and where each is declared, its parsed dependency edges, the ordered runtime path from a model-visible call to an effect, where approval/Grant/Stop is enforced, what exists on the DSH-native side, and the retirement readiness DERIVED from the measured retirement artifacts. WHAT IT IS NOT: a retirement licence (that is scripts/ute-retirement-gate.mjs + the required-CI deletion hook), a proof that the new path is correct, or a claim that the old path is equivalent. THE INDEPENDENT INPUTS the checker grades this ledger against: the census (family set, lanes, members, mount), the git index (tracked files, and the file universe derived from the booked lanes), the source text (imports parsed by a tokenizer, not a regex), and the retirement ledger + its measured baseline/new-path/negative-control artifacts. FIELDS: oldPath.files[].role uses the closed set [family-definition,row-definition,executor,mechanics,port,normalizer,contribution,index,test-only] (mechanics is also the class of bound helper/law/constants modules); dependsOn = bare module specifiers (node:* and @scope packages) actually imported by oldPath.files; importsWithinFamily/importsAcrossRepo = relative specifiers partitioned by whether they resolve inside this family's own files; runtimePath steps name a file this family owns, a declared shared file (shared:true), another family's file (owner:<familyId>), or an external step (external:true + where); retirementReadiness is recomputed by the checker from the retirement gate's own coverage derivation, so a declared value that the evidence does not support is INVENTORY_READINESS_DRIFT.

The closed contribution registry (`DUP_FAMILY_ID` / name-claim law) every family contribution registers through. Shared.
The controlled-fs profile (`isBeneath`, `verifyOpenedHandle`, the post-consume closures) the fs read/write/edit/image executors run over. Shared runtime module.
`createConfinedProcessProvider` — the confined process/shell backend the process and search executors spawn through. Shared runtime module.
